description.p: Jmail is a GTK4 email client with Vim-style, Gmail-compatible keyboard shortcuts, a joined inbox, a fast local cache and a Gmail-style conversation view.

ul.li: OAuth sign-in for Google, IMAP/SMTP for other providers
Unified inbox across accounts with folders and special-use mailboxes
Local SQLite cache with full-text search
Automatic background sync with IMAP IDLE and polling fallback

description.p: Initial development milestone: application shell and layout.
